name: Revilla del Campo (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Revilla del Campo (a bull, a spade, a rose and a castle).
history: Municipal flag of Revilla del Campo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Revilla del Campo arms — bull, spade, rose and castle
